Affine.description: Evaluated affine transform, not author rotation/flip/viewport semantics.

linear.description: Dimensionless Q32 in row-major order: xx, xy, yx, yy.

translation.description: Q32 in the same coordinate unit as the input point.

linear.description: Nonnegative outward bounds, raw dimensionless Q32.

translation.description: Nonnegative outward bounds, raw Q32 EMU.

BlendMode.description: Porter-Duff composition, separate from the source brush and geometry mask.

oneOf.description:
Immutable full-viewport pixels before draw `after_draws`, after group
boundaries at that position. Device-aligned; path/view transforms do not
move it. Scope selects a canvas, never an implicit host resource.

ClipNode.description:
Evaluated intersection path; geometry has its own transform. Parent clipping
remains in world coordinates and is never transformed by a child or draw.

oneOf.description: ECMA does not give coefficients. This profile explicitly uses 22/72/6.
2016 table says 250,250,120 for ltGoldenrodYellow, unlike its long alias.

rgba8.description: Never feed these quantized samples back into native expressions.

DrawScene.description: Evaluated resources/instances, independent of authoring document semantics.

opacityGroups.description: Intervals refer to instances; lowering preserves their order and count.

embed.description:
Each relationship belongs to the part in its own declaring origin.
Empty strings are explicit or profile-default empty relationship IDs.

EffectiveLineGeometry.description:
Stroke geometry is independent of paint. Table lines can therefore use the
complete fill engine, including gradient/pattern paint, without losing dash,
compound, alignment, cap, join or endpoint declarations.

Emu.description: Signed int64 EMU. 1 point = 12700 EMU. Range requires semantic validation.

placeholder.description: Present only when evaluation actually consulted a native reference.

contextOwner.description:
Resolve a style reference color in this native owner only if color
evaluation actually reaches phClr. Inheritance does not sample colors.

oneOf.description: Physical DrawingML chart declaration, not a slide shape/native ID.
Image relationships remain in style; this is not a transparent paint.
Same order and cardinality as style.gradient.stops; never sorted/deduped.

commands.description: Local Q32 EMU; open contours are implicitly closed for filling.

sourcePart.description: Shared table declarations live outside the consuming object's surface.

oneOf.description:
Physical cell formatting. Covered cells remain queryable; page painting
selects merge origins separately.

A real table-style declaration instantiated by this native table. None
selects tblBg. Also identifies the exact lazy phClr reference context.

FixedQ32.description: Signed i128 integer divided by 2^32. Coordinate unit is specified by the owning geometry profile; semantic range validation required.

GeometryOrigin.description:
Ordinals are zero-based element preorder in the indicated XML resource.
Preset ordinals address the pinned, generated catalog definition, not the
document part. A document override always retains its physical source.

stops.description:
Nondecreasing positions in [0,1]. Repeated positions are hard stops.
Missing endpoint positions extend the first/last color to that endpoint.

oneOf.description:
First closed ellipse membership for q=((2u-1)*scaleX,(2v-1)*scaleY).
At t=0 the ellipse has innerCenter and innerRadii; at t=1 it is the
unit circle at the origin. Non-nested families use the first entry.

uncertainty.description:
Nonnegative Q32 errors ordered scaleX/Y, centerX/Y, radiusX/Y.
They bound geometry parameters, not a uniform scalar/color error.

oneOf.description:
t = coefficients[0] * u + coefficients[1] * v + coefficients[2].
u,v are the independently tiled/clamped coordinates in [0,1].

uncertainty.description: Nonnegative dimensionless Q32 errors, before float conversion.

oneOf.description:
Maximum of four inward edge fields and zero. Rates are ordered left,
top, right, bottom; a zero rate disables that edge. Positive rates give
1-u*left, 1-v*top, 1-(1-u)*right and 1-(1-v)*bottom respectively.

Office's endpoint-pair RGB curve, exponent 15/8; alpha stays linear.
Requires two endpoint stops or a symmetric three-stop ramp, straight alpha.

origin.description: World Q32 EMU position of the unit tile's top-left corner.

xStep.description: World displacement for a unit change in each tile coordinate.

origin.description: Nonnegative Q32 world EMU error per input parameter.

srgb.description:
Straight sRGB working channels. Finite RGB may exceed [0,1]; alpha must
be in [0,1]. No RGBA8 quantization is performed before interpolation.

origin.description: World Q32 EMU position of source pixel boundary (0, 0).

sourceDomain.description:
Optional continuous source pixel domain; may extend beyond the resource
into transparent space. Coordinates are Q32 pixels, not world EMU.

uncertainty.description:
Outward errors from upstream layout/placement. These participate in the
same device budget as float conversion, including repeated tile phase.

xStep.description: World Q32 EMU displacement per source pixel, not endpoint coordinates.

origin.description: Nonnegative Q32 world EMU errors; rebase never changes these bounds.

sourceDomain.description:
Nonnegative Q32 source pixel errors, left/top/right/bottom. Must be zero
when the brush has no explicit source domain.

xStep.description: Nonnegative Q32 world EMU per source pixel.

LineColorExpression.description:
Retains native color operations and their owning style context. Colors are
not sampled/quantized during line inheritance; color evaluation is separate.

oneOf.description: Physical DrawingML chart declaration, not a slide shape/native ID.

NativeCoordinate.description: Native coordinate: bounded integer EMU or exact decimal universal measure.

NativePercentage.description: Exact native percentage: int32 thousandths of a percent or decimal percent; ranges depend on use.

affine.description: Already in surface coordinates; subtract anchor, then apply once.

sourceSize.description:
Effective coordinate viewport. A zero/missing group child extent uses
the corresponding target extent, producing unit scale on that axis.

OpacityGroup.description:
Render the complete interval onto transparent pixels, then source-over it
onto its parent with a single opacity. This is not per-paint alpha.

endDraw.description: Exclusive, and strictly greater than first_draw.

opacity.description: 0 is transparent; 65535 is opaque. Linear coverage of premultiplied sRGB.

brush.description: Already evaluated world-space paint, independent of this path transform.

stroke.description: Evaluated world-width stroke; not transformed by the geometry matrix.

numerator.description: Positive rational pixels per EMU; normalized internally.

background.description: Straight sRGB RGBA8; output is premultiplied.

origin.description: Q32 EMU. Subtracted before converting to device-space float32.

graphicFrameOrientationIgnored.description:
Office ignores a graphic frame's own orientation attributes; parent
group orientation still applies. The original values remain above.

combinedCoordinateErrorBound.description: Transform + final device quantization, raw Q32 pixels.

loweringAttempts.description:
2 means the shared matrix candidate failed numeric/precision checks and
lowering used the original node chain before any backend call.

pointTransformWork.description: Conservative point/node work per attempt, including identity instances.

transformErrorBound.description: Quantization/composition error bound, raw Q32 document units (EMU).

SnapshotScope.description:
The source canvas at a capture point. Explicit captures may be consumed
later in any group; their pixels remain immutable after the source closes.

oneOf.description: Legacy local capture: use must stay in its original innermost group.
Root output, excluding any unmerged active group surfaces.
Zero-based opacity-group index; must be active at the capture point.

contextOverride.description:
A background redirect may change context within the same drawing batch.
Absent means the enclosing batch's color mapping and scheme apply.

imageClipCoordinateErrorBound.description:
Upstream image fill-rectangle clip error in Q32 device pixels, before
shared scene lowering. Image brush uncertainty is accounted downstream.

pathCoordinateErrorBound.description:
Relative to evaluated binary64 guide values. Does not bound upstream
guide evaluation, coverage, color or application compatibility.

drawingSurface.description:
The object's own drawing surface supplies ordinary color/style context.
useBgFill explicitly redirects to the consuming slide's background.
Placeholder inheritance retains original declaration owners.

pictureFill.description: p:blipFill is a second fill above spPr fill and below the outline.

region.description: Explicit native receiver rectangle, in object-local coordinates.

tableStroke.description: Independent native edge geometry; fill.target identifies the cell/edge.

fillTarget.description:
Present for the distinct p:blipFill paint. Ordinary shape/text paints
retain their existing provenance through binding/path/text_sources.

oneOf.description: Missing relationship or matching placeholder; no synthetic geometry.
Slide idx=0xffffffff is explicitly detached from layout matching.

Limit 1..=1024, dimensionless Q32. Clip perpendicular to the exterior
bisector at half-width * limit. Exact reversals use a bevel join.

width.description: Q32 page/world EMU. Zero explicitly requests a device hairline.

parent.description: Optional outer transform. Parents must precede children.

oneOf.description: Schema/profile default at the selected transform's owner.
